details.title: SERVICES AGREEMENT (Rheinwerk Insight pipeline)
details.governing_law: laws of the Federal Republic of Germany

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG).

details.parties_quote: Rheinwerk Analytics GmbH, Leopoldstraße 184, 80804 München, Germany, registered in the commercial register of the Local Court (Amtsgericht) of Munich under HRB 241873, VAT ID DE318442907, represented by its Managing Director (Geschäftsführer), Mr. Stefan Brandt — hereinafter "Client" — and AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, represented by its Director — hereinafter "Supplier" —

payment_source.quote: Supplier shall invoice each Milestone Fee after acceptance of the relevant Milestone. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt without deduction.

details.services_summary: Design, implement, and hand over a new data ingestion and processing layer for Client's Rheinwerk Insight platform, including migration of 22 batch jobs.

liability_cap.quote: In the case of slightly negligent breach of a material contractual obligation (Kardinalpflicht), liability shall be limited to the foreseeable damage typical for this type of contract, and in any event to the total remuneration under this Agreement.

delay_penalty.quote: If Supplier is in default with a Milestone for reasons for which it is responsible, Client may claim a contractual penalty (Vertragsstrafe) of 0.5% of the Milestone Fee of the affected Milestone for each full week of delay, up to a maximum of 5% of that Milestone Fee.

findings.title: Northwind Logistics: Reusing tools or frameworks (including the PipeKit accelerator) built into Northwind's deliverables
findings.why: Involves pipekit in text hints, which may collide with restrictions on reusing tools or frameworks built into Northwind's deliverables.
findings.comparison: PipeKit as delivered to Northwind belongs to Northwind. Check before promising to reuse PipeKit 'like we did for Northwind'.
findings.quote: All Intellectual Property Rights in the Deliverables, including any software, tools, frameworks, libraries and pre-existing materials incorporated into the Deliverables, shall vest in the Client absolutely upon payment of the Charges for the relevant Milestone.
findings.exception: SOW-1 builds the pipeline with AtliQ's proprietary PipeKit accelerator, which is incorporated into the deliverable, so rights in that PipeKit configuration pass to Northwind on payment.

findings.title: Perpetual, irrevocable license granted for proprietary tool
findings.why: Grants an irrevocable, perpetual, royalty-free license to AtliQ's proprietary PipeKit tool to client and affiliates.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles state AtliQ keeps its own pre-existing tools; granting a perpetual license may risk proprietary assets.
findings.quote: Supplier hereby grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free right to use, reproduce, modify and operate PipeKit

findings.title: Indian entity under non-Indian law (laws of the Federal Republic of Germany)
findings.why: Disputes would be fought under foreign law and courts.
findings.comparison: Principle: India for AtliQ Pvt Ltd. Past exceptions (Al Noor DIFC, Northwind English law) were deliberate.
findings.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG).

findings.title: Subcontracting Restricted
findings.why: Limits AtliQ's operational flexibility to use subcontractors without client approval.
findings.comparison: Unusual restriction compared to standard flexibility.
findings.quote: Supplier may subcontract parts of the services only with Client's prior written consent.

findings.title: CloudSpan Technologies: Acting as implementation, reseller or referral partner for any competing cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or analytics platform
findings.why: Mentions lakehouse in text hints, which may touch upon acting as implementation partner for competing platforms within specified regions.
findings.comparison: Do not partner with another cloud data-warehouse or lakehouse vendor in India or the GCC while the CloudSpan agreement runs.
findings.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.
findings.exception: Clause 7.3: does not restrict services outside India and the GCC, or to a customer that independently selected a platform, provided AtliQ holds no partner appointment with, and receives no fee from, that platform's provider.

findings.title: Client acquires exclusive rights upon full payment
findings.comparison: In line with principles that client owns deliverables on payment and AtliQ keeps pre-existing tools.
findings.quote: Except for PipeKit, Client shall acquire the exclusive, perpetual, transferable and unrestricted right of use in all Work Results created specifically for Client, upon full payment of the relevant Milestone Fee.

findings.title: Delay penalty of 0.5 percent per week
findings.why: Imposes delay penalties for missed milestones.
findings.comparison: Matches Acme, Northwind and Trustline benchmarks (0.5% per week, capped at 5%).
findings.quote: Client may claim a contractual penalty (Vertragsstrafe) of 0.5% of the Milestone Fee of the affected Milestone for each full week of delay, up to a maximum of 5% of that Milestone Fee.

findings.title: Exclusion of client-caused and force majeure delays
findings.why: Protects AtliQ from penalties caused by client or outside events.
findings.comparison: Fully aligns with AtliQ principles excluding client-caused delays and outside events.
findings.quote: No penalty shall be payable to the extent the delay is caused by Client, including by failure to fulfil its cooperation duties under § 3, or by force majeure.
